svg.aria-label: Root locus of K over s(s + 3) squared: branches from 0 and from the double pole at minus 3 meet at the break-away point minus 1 when K = 4, then follow the plus and minus 60 degree asymptotes from minus 2, crossing the imaginary axis at plus or minus j3 when K = 54; the third branch runs left from minus 3
svg.title: Root locus of K over s(s + 3) squared: branches from 0 and from the double pole at minus 3 meet at the break-away point minus 1 when K = 4, then follow the plus and minus 60 degree asymptotes from minus 2, crossing the imaginary axis at plus or minus j3 when K = 54; the third branch runs left from minus 3

g.text: × poles 0 and −3 (double) · orange: break-away −1 · asymptotes ±60°, 180° from σa = −2
